newShoot.title: Start a new shoot?
newShoot.body: You have approvals or adjustments that have not been submitted. If you start a new shoot now, they will be lost.
setup.title: Edit a shoot
setup.intro: Choose the folder with your photos, where the edited copies should be saved, and a folder of finished photos in the style you want. VivahLens learns your look from those and edits the whole shoot. Your original photos are never changed or uploaded.
setup.input.label: Photos to edit
setup.input.help: The folder that holds the shoot (RAW or JPEG files, directly inside it and not in sub-folders).
setup.output.label: Save edited photos to
setup.output.help: Approved photos are saved here as JPEG files. The folder is created if it does not exist.
setup.output.unused: This editor route writes sidecar files next to your photos and does not export, so no output folder is needed.
setup.profile.label: Your style photos
setup.profile.help: A folder of finished photos that show the look you want. Up to {max} of them are used.
setup.path.placeholder: Choose a folder, or paste its full path
setup.check.photos: {count, plural, one {# photo found} other {# photos found}}
setup.check.styleCount: {count, plural, one {# photo found} other {# photos found}}; up to {max} are used to learn your style.
setup.check.noPhotos: No photos in this folder. They must be directly inside it, not in a sub-folder.
setup.check.willCreate: This folder does not exist yet. It will be created.
setup.check.outputHasPhotos: {count, plural, one {This folder already has # photo. A new photo with the same name will replace it.} other {This folder already has # photos. New photos with the same names will replace them.}}
setup.model.label: AI model
setup.modelName.label: Model name
setup.modelName.help: The model to use, as your provider names it.
setup.model.demoNote: Demo mode: every photo gets the same sample edit. Choose a real AI model under Advanced options to edit for real.
setup.model.cloudNote: Reduced previews without location data are sent to {provider}. Its key must be set in the environment before VivahLens is started.
setup.fixFields: Choose the folders above to start.
setup.privacy: Originals are never changed or uploaded. Only reduced previews can leave this computer, and only if you choose a cloud model.
setup.failed: The last edit did not finish: {message}
setup.stopped: Editing was stopped. Photos that were already done are saved; press Start editing to carry on.

picker.error.FAILED: Something went wrong while reading folders.

progress.intro: This can take a few minutes for a large shoot. You can leave this page open.
progress.stage.culled: Setting aside blurry and duplicate photos

detail.title: Editing {name}
editing.paused.expired: Editing is paused: this license ran out and could not be renewed. You can still approve and export. Connect to the internet and run “vivah license” to renew it.
editing.paused.subscription: Editing is paused: the subscription is not active. You can still approve and export. Renew it to keep editing.
editing.paused.device: Editing is paused: this computer is no longer activated. You can still approve and export. Run “vivah activate” to use this computer again.

privacy.unavailable: No record of transfers is kept for this session.
